Hon'ble Shri Justice Rakesh Mohan Pandey Order on Board 18-10-2023
1.

The petitioner has filed this petition seeking following relief:-
"It is therefore, prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to allow this
petition and to direct the police authorities to immediately arrest the accused persons
of the case bearing Crime No.45/2023 registered by the police of Police Station
Duldula, District Jashpur (C.G.) for the offences under Section 376 (2) (n), 506 Read
with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code against the accused persons, in the interest of
justice."

2. Learned counsel for the State would submit that the grievance of the petitioner has already been redressed as one accused namely David Khalkho has been arrested whereas other co-accused persons have been extended benefit of Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
3. At this stage learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the grievance of the petitioner has been redressed, therefore, he seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this petition.
5. Accordingly, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
